summary: Adds an integrated operator guide for self-hosted Entra SSO, administrator access, headless configuration, and engine-scoped role assignments.
userImpact: Operators can follow one worked configuration example for platform administration and access to a specific engine.
configuration: Documents existing bootstrap settings, Entra provider configuration, secret references, configuration-bundle application, and scoped role assignments; no runtime settings are added or changed.
security: Clarifies SSO administrator permissions versus local recovery membership, verified MFA evidence, and local-session refresh and revocation behavior.
knownLimitations: Provider setup and connection tests do not replace a controlled Entra sign-in in the target deployment.
rollback: Revert the documentation change; no runtime, database, or configuration rollback is required.
validation: The documentation-boundary guard and documentation-contract gate validate the guide and its schema-tagged JSON examples.
The full embedded bundle is compiled with the repository configuration compiler, including SSO administrator and exact engine-scope references.
All three Mermaid sequences were rendered and visually inspected; publication preserves their checked sources.
